messages:
ashwin: Heads-up — thinking about adding a "snapshot lock" step to config rollforward to prevent racy applies when multiple people hit apply at once. Wanted ops/console POV. cc @tess

tess: sgtm, how would the lock interact with preview/dry-run in the console? We shouldn't lock for people just previewing the impact.

ashwin: proposal: two-phase lock: READ_LOCK during preview (non-blocking reads), UPGRADE->WRITE_LOCK at final apply. Default lock TTL 60s, configurable per rollout. Acquire is optimistic, upgrade uses CAS with token.

jamie: how do we surface TTL/owner in the console? need a clear "who holds lock" state and a quick "force-release" flow. Also must show audit info (owner, reason, timestamp).

leo: telemetry note — capture events: lock_acquire, lock_upgrade, lock_release with fields {trace_id, snapshot_id, holder, latency_ms}. Sample 1% full traces, but emit counters for all. If lock_acquire latency >200ms, flame an alert.

ashwin: rough API sketch:
```
POST /api/v1/config/rollforward
{ "snapshot_id": "s-2026-04-01-0001", "mode": "dry-run|apply", "lock_ttl_ms": 60000 }
```
Response includes `lock_token` and `lock_state` when acquired. Upgrade endpoint:
```
POST /api/v1/config/lock/upgrade
{ "lock_token": "abc123", "expected_version": 42 }
```
Upgrade returns new `lock_token` or conflict error.

tess: ok, console flow idea: preview uses mode=dry-run + read_lock=true (so previewers see a consistent snapshot). Console shows a lock badge with holder and TTL countdown. "Request lock" button that queues you and shows position.

jamie: queueing is fine but ops wants backoff + max-wait 30s. Also add operator_override but gate it behind audit + slack-notify to #eng-platform. Maybe require a short reason.

ashwin: operator_override endpoint would require reason and auditor_email. To keep initial rollout simple, allow force-release via `POST /api/v1/config/lock/force-release` and log the reason + user. We can iterate on stricter flows if abuse occurs.

ops-bot: deploy-check: snapshot-lock feature flag enabled in staging clusters. CI will run e2e against lock logic at 1700123458.

leo: can we add metrics: lock_contention_count, avg_queue_time_ms, lock_holders_over_time? Those will help tune TTL and default backoff.

tess: also add a "dry-run replay" link in the console so reviewers can rerun the exact dry-run without holding the write lock (useful for audits).

jamie: agreed. Next steps: ashwin to open API PR + design doc; tess to mock console badge/queue UX; leo to draft telemetry dashboard and alerts. Sync tomorrow 11:00am.

ashwin: thanks — i'll open the PR and ping here when ready.
